limitations: comment[label] values are free text and fail the PRIDE ontology check in parse_sdrf (4 errors, all in comment[label]); PRIDE has no diethyl-labeling terms, and the only other label terms (SILAC, dimethyl, 13C heavy) would misstate the chemistry. All other columns validate.

Diethyl label mass shifts (light +56.063 Da, heavy +60.076 Da per PRIDE data protocol) are not in comment[modification parameters]: UNIMOD:518 Diethyl is a different composition (+28.03), so no verified accession was used. The labels are recorded in comment[label] only.

Each RAW file appears on two rows (light and heavy halves of the 1:1 mixture); the SDRF builder cannot place one file under two sources, so the heavy rows were created by scripted copy of the light rows.
Age 30Y6M and sex female are Cellosaurus values for HeLa, not stated in the deposit. Organism part, cell type and disease set to not available (the deposit says only 'Hela cell').

Biological replicate is 1 for both labeling versions; whether the 13C and 2H experiments used the same lysate batch is not stated. Technical replicate = injection number in file name. No factor value column: the two labeling versions are separate RAW sets and differ in comment[label].
Precursor tolerance, reduction and alkylation reagents are not stated. Full text of the paper (PMID 26377011) was not open in Europe PMC and was not read; no claim cites it.
The deposit also contains PXD001256_community_annotated.sdrf.tsv; it was not used as a source for this annotation.

SANDBOX ONLY (independent review FAIL): comment[label] uses free-text 'Diethyl 13C/2H light/heavy' values, which parse_sdrf rejects (4 errors) because no diethyl-labeling term exists in the PRIDE/MS vocabularies; PRIDE:0000513 Dimethyl Labeling would validate but names the wrong chemistry, and 'not available' is rejected for the label column. The diethyl mass shifts (+56.063 / +60.076 Da) are not in the modification column (UNIMOD:518 Diethyl is a different composition).
